business_summary: Shanghai Yimin Commercial Group Co., Ltd. engages in the commercial wholesale and retail, commercial property leasing, and catering and tourism businesses in China. It is involved in the domestic trade, photography, computer leasing, self-owned property leasing, real estate sales, industrial investment, self-operation and agency, and import and export business of various commodities and technologies. The company also engages in hotels, catering and tourism, industrial investment, and other businesses, as well as commercial property leasing and operation; sells watches and eyeglasses; clothing and apparel sales, and comprehensive services. In addition, it offers commercial wholesale and retail products under the Gujin Underwear, Tianbao Longfeng, Xingguang Photography, Jinlong Socks, and Shanghai Bedding brands. Further, the company provides underwear, gold and silver jewelry, photographic equipment, bedding, property leasing, hotel, catering and tourism, and elderly care services; and industrial production and manufacturing, investment management, consulting, and investment management consulting services. Additionally, it offers real estate development and management; and commercial complex management services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Yimin Commercial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Yimin Commercial Group Co., Ltd. in November 2010. Shanghai Yimin Commercial Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Shanghai, China.
